assets._note: Image files in StreamingAssets/Content. Replace a file with the same name, or change the name here.

lines.start.greeting: Hi! I'm {mascot}. Let's check how you stand!
lines.scan.pointAtFloor: Point the camera at the floor where your child will stand.
lines.scan.noFloor: Point at the floor in a lit area.
lines.scan.unavailable: Floor scan is not available on this phone. Skipping it.
lines.turn.instruction: Turn the phone around and put it here, screen facing the room.
lines.setup.stepIn: Step in front of the camera.
lines.front.tryAgain: Oops, you moved! Let's try once more.
lines.side.turn: Now turn sideways, like you are walking past me!
lines.side.holdStill: Stand still and look straight ahead!
lines.side.tryAgain: Oops, you moved! Let's try once more.

thresholds._kneeNote: Knee bend in the front view: positive = knee towards the middle (knock-knee), negative = outwards (bow-leg).
thresholds._headNote: Head forward: ear's horizontal distance in front of the shoulder divided by torso length (side view).

measurement._note: Each value is the median over a still window. stillTolerance is a fraction of torso length.
measurement._sideNote: Sideways when shoulder width on screen is below this fraction of torso length.

camera._note: Front camera vertical field of view in degrees; tune per test phone.
